tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rigs par smra ba grags bzang la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rigs par smra ba grags bzang la spring ba/ gang la blo dang nges pa phun tshogs shing*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal gyi bzo yod kyang*// rgyu 'bras las la 'dzem pa'i yid dang ni// ngo tsha khrel yod gnyen po dang bral na// yon tan de dag skyon gyi dpung gyur nas// 'dir ni mchog dman kun gyi smad 'gyur zhing*// phyi mar brnag dka'i sdug bsngal myong 'gyur ba// shes rab gsal ba khyod kyi cis mi shes// 'di 'dra shes shing shes pa ji bzhin du// blo rtse ldan pa gzhan gyis 'doms byas kyang*// da dung dwang du mi len slar zhing du// myos pas myos la gzhan gyis ci byar yod// da dung thub la ston pa'i 'du shes dang*// kho bo la yang bla mar sems byed na// dug la dug tu shes nas spang ba dang*// nye bar gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'ang btung bgyis dang*// thub pa tshangs par gyur pas myong byed cing*// dbang sgyur rgyal po dang ni bran bzang la// zla ba ji bzhin khyod la bdag 'gyur ro// des ni phun sum tshogs kyang phun tshogs nyid// khyod 'dra'i dpal mi 'gyur ba de bas na// drang srong gnas su drang po'i 'jug tshul legs// dang po'i las pas gzhan sems bsrungs pa bas// bdag sems bsrungs na bdag gzhan thams cad kyi// sems bsrung 'gyur zhing de la dpal kun yang*// 'du bar 'gyur zhes mkhas rnams mthun par smra// 'di ni yi ge thengs pa'i theng yig ste// 'di nyid yi ge'i rten gyi mchog kyang yin// nyes pa'i nad sel bkru sman dam pa dang*// dge ba'i lus zungs 'phel byed sman yang 'di// 'di ni zhe sdang gnyen po'i nor zla yin// zla ba mig gis mthong tshe bris pa yin// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
